peer_identity.arc_label: Sacred androgyne from imperial embryo to reigning empress across multiple generations
peer_identity.honcho_notes: Conjoined-twin androgyne; biologically male and female simultaneously. Created after 30 years of effort on a hospital-planet. Messianic figure expected to unite all factions. Targeted by Shabda-Oud succession plot (Sama-Wajd prophesied to dethrone her). Commands Purple Endoguard. Rarely speaks directly in surviving pages—acts as political anchor rather than active voice.
peer_identity.rationale: All records describe the same entity at different life stages. Vol03 is the embryo/sacred egg; vol04 is the named assassination target of the Oiders' plot; vol07–10 are the reigning empress of the galaxy. No direct voice exists in any record (vol10 has minimal implied agency). No contradictory TRAIT facts arise from merging—the entity transitions from embryo to ruler but remains consistently the target of dethronement plots and the political anchor of the galactic order.
